重判修正版：短输出提示词与配对翻转综合分析
Corrected Rejudgment: Integrated Short-Output Prompt and Paired-Flip Analysis

作者 / Author: spinner-bot（GitHub）

本报告以本地大模型对 10,000 条原始输出的复判为正确性分析依据，同时保留规则判别结果以量化判别器差异。复判结果不是独立人工金标准；文中明确区分模型判别、人工抽样核查和对照 benchmark 答案。
This report uses local-LLM re-adjudication of all 10,000 raw outputs for correctness analyses, while retaining rule-based labels to quantify detector differences. LLM adjudication is not an independent human gold standard; model judgments, sampled manual audit, and benchmark answers are distinguished throughout.

数据与判别方法 / Data and adjudication

冻结样本共 2,000 题，每题在 S0、SC、S1、S2、S3 五种条件下各有一个原始输出，总计 10,000 条。原规则标签完整保留；本地 Qwen3.8-27B 对每条原始回答独立提取 ANSWERED/AMBIGUOUS/NO_ANSWER 状态及最终选项，正确性随后机械地与冻结 benchmark 答案比对。AMBIGUOUS 和 NO_ANSWER 在主准确率中计为不正确，并单独报告。

The frozen sample contains 2,000 questions, each with one raw response under S0, SC, S1, S2, and S3 (10,000 responses total). Original rule labels are preserved. Local Qwen3.8-27B independently extracts ANSWERED/AMBIGUOUS/NO_ANSWER and a final option from each response; correctness is then mechanically compared with the frozen benchmark answer. AMBIGUOUS and NO_ANSWER count as incorrect in primary accuracy and are reported separately.

判别器对比与核查 / Detector comparison and audit

规则与模型正确性标签在 10,000 条中有 2,707 条不一致；规则判别正确率为 65.97%，模型复判对应为 88.08%，正确性 Cohen’s κ=0.285。在双方均给出选项的 9,991 条中，选项字母完全一致 7,063 条（70.69%）。这是显著的判别器差异，而非对模型复判准确性的独立证明。

Across 10,000 records, the rule and LLM correctness labels disagree on 2,707. Rule accuracy is 65.97%, compared with 88.08% for LLM adjudication; correctness Cohen’s κ=0.285. Among 9,991 records where both supplied an option, exact option-letter agreement is 7,063 (70.69%). This is a substantial detector difference, not independent proof that LLM adjudication is correct.

分层人工核查 / Stratified manual audit

人工逐条检查 209 个预先抽取样本：规则/模型答案一致与不一致各层在五个条件内均抽取 20 条，并纳入全部 9 条 AMBIGUOUS/NO_ANSWER 输出（8 条歧义、1 条无答案）。209 条中未观察到模型状态或选项提取错误（观察匹配率 100.0%）；9 条边界输出均被人工确认适当标为歧义/无答案。由于分层设计刻意过采规则/模型分歧，209 条简单合并比例不是总体误差率的无偏估计；零观察错误也不代表总体误差为零。

We manually inspected 209 preselected records: within each of the five conditions, 20 same-option and 20 different-option rule/LLM records were sampled, and all 9 AMBIGUOUS/NO_ANSWER outputs were included (eight ambiguous, one unanswered). No state/option extraction error was observed (sample match rate 100.0%); all nine boundary outputs were confirmed as appropriately ambiguous/unanswerable. Because the design deliberately oversamples detector disagreements, the unweighted 209-record rate is not an unbiased population error rate; zero observed errors does not imply zero population error.

Token 长度与长尾 / Token length and long tail

Token 计数直接取原始 vLLM usage 字段，而不是由替代 tokenizer 估算。五种模式均呈明显右偏（均值高于中位数，偏度为正），P95 长尾组准确率低于各自总体准确率；长输出与错误相关，但该观察不说明因果方向。

Token counts come directly from original vLLM usage fields rather than a substitute tokenizer. All five modes are strongly right-skewed (mean above median, positive skew); P95-tail accuracy is lower than the corresponding overall accuracy. Long outputs are associated with errors, but this does not establish causal direction.

研究方向评估 / Research-direction assessment

在修正输出判别后，提示词带来的主要、稳健变化是回答长度下降，而不是准确率提升。S1 与 S3 的平均 completion token 分别约为 S0 的 53% 与 49%；但准确率相对 S0 分别为 -1.20% 与 -0.75%，多重比较校正后没有达到统计显著。当前数据支持“可压缩输出且准确率大致接近”的描述，不支持“提示词提高准确率”或“长度导致正确性变化”的因果结论。

After correcting response adjudication, the clearest robust prompt effect is shorter output, not higher accuracy. Mean completion tokens for S1 and S3 are approximately 53% and 49% of S0. Their accuracy differences from S0 are -1.20 and -0.75 percentage points; neither remains statistically significant after multiplicity correction. The evidence supports “shorter outputs with broadly similar accuracy,” not an accuracy gain or a causal effect of length.

所有五组的 token 长度分布都有明显右偏，且 P95 长尾样本准确率低于该模式总体准确率；这使长输出样本成为值得继续研究的对象，但需区分复杂样本、犹豫/自我修正、回答质量与截断等可能机制，现有相关性不能识别机制。

All five token-length distributions are strongly right-skewed, and P95-tail accuracy is below each mode’s overall accuracy. Long-output cases merit further study, while possible mechanisms—task difficulty, hesitation/self-correction, answer quality, or truncation—must remain distinct; the current associations do not identify a mechanism.

S0/S1/S3 配对翻转 / S0/S1/S3 paired flips

状态码顺序为 S0–S1–S3，1=答对、0=答错。主分析保留工作3原定的 S0/S1/S3 范围。基于复判标签，三组全对为 1,688（84.40%），三组全错为 168（8.40%）；基线错题中至少一个提示条件改对共 57 题，基线对题中至少一个提示条件转错共 87 题。

State-code order is S0–S1–S3, with 1=correct and 0=incorrect. The primary analysis retains Work 3’s original S0/S1/S3 scope. Under corrected labels, 1,688 samples (84.40%) are correct in all three modes and 168 (8.40%) are wrong in all three. At least one prompt condition recovers 57 baseline errors; at least one prompt condition loses 87 baseline-correct answers.

S2 范围判断 / S2 scope decision

S2 经复判从旧规则准确率 60.50% 修正为 88.25%，但这主要反映判别器修正。S2 对 S0/S1/S3 的配对准确率差分别为 -0.50、+0.70、+0.25 个百分点，Holm 校正 p 值分别为 0.736、0.525、0.736。其相对 S0 有 45 次错转对、55 次对转错；S2 特有的基线错题恢复 11 例、特有损失 22 例。S2 与 S1/S3 至少一个不一致的样本为 133（6.65%），因此它并非逐题完全冗余；但当前准确率差异和唯一翻转规模均不足以显示其产生了不可忽略的总体收益。故工作3主报告维持 S0/S1/S3，不扩展为 S2 主分析。

LLM adjudication changes S2 accuracy from 60.50% under the old rule labels to 88.25%, primarily reflecting detector correction. Paired accuracy differences for S2 versus S0/S1/S3 are -0.50, +0.70, and +0.25 pp; Holm-adjusted p-values are 0.736, 0.525, and 0.736. Versus S0, S2 has 45 wrong-to-correct and 55 correct-to-wrong flips; its unique baseline-error recoveries number 11 and unique losses 22. S2 differs from at least one of S1/S3 on 133 samples (6.65%), so it is not itemwise redundant. However, neither the accuracy contrasts nor the unique-flip volume show a non-negligible overall benefit. The primary Work 3 report therefore retains S0/S1/S3 and does not expand its core scope to S2.

解释边界 / Interpretation limits

  • LLM 复判用于修正明显不可靠的规则选项提取，但仍可能出错；人工核查为分层样本审计，不能当作 10,000 条的完整人工金标准。
    LLM adjudication replaces unreliable rule parsing but can still err; the stratified audit does not constitute full human gold labeling of all 10,000 records.
  • 准确率依赖冻结 benchmark 答案的正确性；对回答的文字提取正确，不代表原回答视觉判断本身正确。
    Accuracy depends on frozen benchmark answers; faithful extraction of a response does not mean the response’s visual judgment is itself correct.
  • 统计显著性、差异大小、分层结构与原始回答需合并解释；相关不能推出因果。
    Significance, effect size, pairing, and raw responses should be interpreted jointly; association is not causation.
  • 开放选项题被模型标为歧义或无答案时，在主准确率中计错；边界状态另行展示，避免隐藏分母。
    Model-labeled ambiguous/unanswered outputs count as incorrect in primary accuracy and are separately shown to keep denominators transparent.
